description: Adopts the shared DIRACGrid Renovate policy (this repository hosts it).

packageRules.description: Upper bounds in pyproject.toml are workarounds for known incompatibilities, so never raise them automatically. The updates are listed in the Dependency Dashboard, where a PR can be requested once the underlying problem is fixed.

customManagers.description: Keep the validator in renovate-config.yml on a current Renovate version.
